item.title: The Ontology Divide Is Not Model Size
item.description: 中文版是这篇文章的默认版本。 阅读中文版 → This English page stays available at this URL; the Chinese version is the one we maintain first. Between December 2025 and November 2026, six papers closed in on one conclusion from three directions. The bottleneck in ontology construction moved from who can write an ontology to who can prove the written thing is right. Every number below goes back to a named section or table. Two minutes twenty-three, voiced in English, captions burned in and switchable in the player.

item.title: Automatic Ontology Engineering: Reading NVIDIA's Auto-Ontology at the Source
item.description: 中文版是这篇文章的默认版本。 阅读中文版 → This English page stays available at this URL; the Chinese version is the one we maintain first. In one line: Auto-Ontology automates the most expensive month of ontology engineering — it reads your metadata and query history, compiles a business ontology, and hands it to agents through nine read-only tools. What it hands over is a draft: in this codebase, certification is a badge rendered for display, not a gate on the query path.
